description: Order, burial and model confidence of the AllF His389 insert, plus family conservation figure
code:
import requests, numpy as np, json, collections
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
UA={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}
t2o=dict(zip("ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL MSE".split(),"ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYVM"))
def fetch(p): return requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.pdb",timeout=180,headers=UA).text.split("\n")
L2=fetch("3DMY")
rows=[]
for l in L2:
    if l.startswith(("ATOM  ","HETATM")) and l[76:78].strip()!="H" and l[16] in(" ","A"):
        rn=l[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in t2o: continue
        rows.append((l[21],int(l[22:26]),t2o[rn],l[12:16].strip(),float(l[54:60]),float(l[60:66]),
                     np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])))
chA=[r for r in rows if r[0]=="A"]
bB={}
for ch,ri,aa,an,occ,b,x in chA: bB.setdefault(ri,[]).append(b)
meanB={k:float(np.mean(v)) for k,v in bB.items()}
allB=np.array(list(meanB.values()))
print("3DMY chain A: %d ordered residues, mean B %.1f (sd %.1f)"%(len(meanB),allB.mean(),allB.std()))
print("insert 385-393 ordered?", [(r, round(meanB[r],1) if r in meanB else "MISSING") for r in range(384,395)])
print("B-factor percentile of His389: %.0f%%"%(100*(allB<meanB[389]).mean()))
# burial: heavy-atom neighbour count within 8 A of the His389 side chain
P=np.array([r[6] for r in chA])
sc389=np.array([r[6] for r in chA if r[1]==389 and r[3] not in("N","CA","C","O")])
cnt=sum(int((np.linalg.norm(P-p,axis=1)<8).sum()) for p in sc389)/len(sc389)
ref=[]
for ri in meanB:
    s=[r[6] for r in chA if r[1]==ri and r[3] not in("N","CA","C","O")]
    if s: ref.append(sum(int((np.linalg.norm(P-p,axis=1)<8).sum()) for p in s)/len(s))
ref=np.array(ref)
print("His389 side-chain neighbour density %.1f (chain mean %.1f, percentile %.0f%% -> %s)"%(
    cnt,ref.mean(),100*(ref<cnt).mean(),"buried" if cnt>ref.mean() else "exposed"))
# AlphaFold pLDDT over the insert
af=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q47208-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120,headers=UA).text.split("\n")
pl={}
for l in af:
    if l.startswith("ATOM  ") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA": pl[int(l[22:26])]=float(l[60:66])
plv=np.array(list(pl.values()))
print("AlphaFold Q47208 mean pLDDT %.1f ; insert 385-393 pLDDT %s"%(plv.mean(),[round(pl[r],1) for r in range(385,394)]))
print("pLDDT at Q467 (canonical His position) = %.1f ; at T341 = %.1f"%(pl[467],pl[341]))

# ---- figure: family conservation ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.4))
ax=axes[0]
cats=["Q","S","T","H","A","V"]; allf=[114,4,3,2,1,1]; sucd=[0,0,0,41,0,0]
w=0.38; x=np.arange(len(cats))
ax.bar(x-w/2,100*np.array(allf)/125,w,label="AllF family (IPR061301), n=125",color="#e07a5f")
ax.bar(x+w/2,100*np.array(sucd)/41,w,label="SCS alpha family (IPR005810), n=41",color="#2d6a4f")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(cats); ax.set_xlabel("residue at PF00549 column 102")
ax.set_ylabel("% of family members"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("A  The SucD catalytic His position is Gln in the AllF family",fontsize=10)
ax=axes[1]
lab=["insertion present\nbetween PF00549\ncols 34 and 35","insertion contains\na histidine"]
ax.bar(np.arange(2)-w/2,[100.0,100.0],w,color="#e07a5f",label="AllF family, n=125")
ax.bar(np.arange(2)+w/2,[0.0,0.0],w,color="#2d6a4f",label="SCS alpha family, n=41")
ax.set_xticks(range(2)); ax.set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=8.5); ax.set_ylabel("% of family members")
ax.set_ylim(0,110); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.text(0.5,55,"consensus insert\n[QNVR]-G-[KR]-P-H-P-M-I-[DE]",ha="center",fontsize=9,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle="round",fc="#fff3e6",ec="#e07a5f"))
ax.set_title("B  A histidine-bearing insert replaces it, family-wide",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
